headline: A 2017 executive order by President Trump on public safety inside the United States, away from its borders.
what_it_does: This executive order was signed by President Donald Trump on January 25, 2017. Its title says it deals with public safety in the interior of the United States, meaning areas inside the country rather than at its borders. No official summary was provided, so the specific rules, programs, or directions it contains cannot be described here.
